note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) English species-level description; the original describes the alate and the soldier, the worker being listed only as a morphotype and not described, so no worker section is given. OCR problems: the caption 'Pig.' is an error for Fig.; 'clypeofrohtal' is an error for clypeofrontal; 'G-hooli' is Ghooli (type locality, consistent with the checklist); 'H- darwini' has a defective genus name. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is very similar to Amitermes vitiosus but most measurements are distinctly smaller; the soldier is most closely related to A. lativentris and A. westraliensis.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, the postclypeus distinctly paler, the wings dark smoky. Head, thorax and abdomen hairy. Head broadly oval. Compound eyes small, only slightly protruding. Ocelli small, broadly oval. Postclypeus length slightly more than half its width, the posterior part strongly convex, slightly arched. Fontanelle lanceolate, with a linear prolongation. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Pronotum as in A. darwini. Posterior lateral angles of mesonotum and metanotum rounded, the posterior margin with a deeper and wider emargination. Radius of forewing almost always absent, always absent in the hind wing; media with 3 or 4 branches, branch 1 situated before or near the middle of the wing; cubitus with about 9 branches. Measurements: length with wings 12.00 mm, length without wings 5.75—6.60 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.51—1.55 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.66—0.74 mm, head width 1.07—1.11 mm, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.25 mm, ocellus length 0.12 mm, pronotum length 0.55—0.59 mm, width 0.91—1.07 mm, forewing length 10.70 mm, width 2.59—2.66 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head ochre yellow-brown; from the clypeofrontal suture to the posterior margin there is almost a large pale area; mandibles dark rusty, darkest at the apex. Head short, wide and deep, longer than wide, widest at the middle, the sides slightly rounded, the posterior part semicircular. Mandibles short and stout, about half as long as the rest of the head, with one very short stout tooth, very close to the base. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 smallest; segment 4 larger than segment 5. Measurements: total length 4.50—5.00 mm, head length (including mandibles) 2.00—2.29 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.48—1.88 mm, head width 1.07—1.29 mm, pronotum length 0.29—0.37 mm, width 0.66—0.74 mm.
